cues: Artificial intelligence is building machines that do jobs which would need human intelligence: learning, reasoning, understanding language, recognising patterns.
Inside it sits machine learning, which learns patterns from data instead of following hand written rules.
Inside that, deep learning, with many layered neural networks.
And inside that, the newest layer: generative AI, the large language models behind ChatGPT, which create new text, code and pictures.
